scored_by: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via scripts/rubric.mjs, two passes per asset (A on the 8x plain view, B on the debug sheet), re-scored after the 2026-11-13 redraw

verdict.note: Re-scored after the lighting-recovery track: derived ramps, one-direction lighting and one interior edge convention on the six redrawn assets, prop untouched. Mean 3.69 against 4.0. Criterion means: silhouette 4.79, cluster_discipline 4.07, value_separation 3.79 (target met), palette_craft 3.36 (target 3.6), lighting 3.07 (target 3.5), edge_language 3.07 (target 3.5). The gate is missed. The control prop moved 3.92->4.00, so the 0.08-0.28 criterion moves are inside the 0.33 single-asset noise. Art iteration stopped per the track stop rule.

silhouette.why: The bottle shape, neck, cork, and liquid level are instantly recognisable at 1x scale without needing colour.

value_separation.why: Most elements are well separated by contrast, though the dark liquid base merges slightly with the dark outline pixels.

lighting.why: Lighting generally comes from the top left, but the liquid shading is handled as horizontal bands rather than consistent directional light.

edge_language.why: The dark outline is consistent around the silhouette, but internal liquid and glass boundaries rely mostly on flat colour changes rather than clear edge treatments.

cluster_discipline.why: Pixels are grouped into clean, readable clusters with no unwanted single-pixel confetti or messy pillow-shading.

palette_craft.why: The colors are appropriate for a potion with distinct ramps for glass, cork, and liquid, though some transitions could be smoother.
